## 函数

| 名称 | 参数 | 返回类型 | 定义 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| product_initiative_unit_economics_snapshot_is_valid | snapshot_value jsonb, negative_reason text, require_negative_reason boolean | boolean | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.product_initiative_unit_economics_snapshot_is_valid(snapshot_value jsonb, negative_reason text, require_negative_reason boolean)<br> RETURNS boolean<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br> IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE<br>AS $function$<br>DECLARE<br>  scenario_code TEXT;<br>  amount_code TEXT;<br>  scenario_value JSONB;<br>  range_value JSONB;<br>  refs_value JSONB;<br>  contribution_value JSONB;<br>  refs_are_unique BOOLEAN;<br>BEGIN<br>  IF snapshot_value IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(snapshot_value) <> 'object' OR<br>     (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(snapshot_value)) <> 4 OR<br>     NOT snapshot_value ?& ARRAY['marketCode','channelCode','currencyCode','scenarios'] OR<br>     jsonb_typeof(snapshot_value->'marketCode') <> 'string' OR<br>     length(btrim(snapshot_value->>'marketCode')) = 0 OR<br>     jsonb_typeof(snapshot_value->'channelCode') <> 'string' OR<br>     length(btrim(snapshot_value->>'channelCode')) = 0 OR<br>     jsonb_typeof(snapshot_value->'currencyCode') <> 'string' OR<br>     snapshot_value->>'currencyCode' !~ '^[A-Z]{3}$' OR<br>     jsonb_typeof(snapshot_value->'scenarios') <> 'object' OR<br>     (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(snapshot_value->'scenarios')) <> 2 OR<br>     NOT (snapshot_value->'scenarios') ?& ARRAY['baseline','conservative'] THEN<br>    RETURN FALSE;<br>  END IF;<br><br>  FOREACH scenario_code IN ARRAY ARRAY['baseline','conservative'] LOOP<br>    scenario_value := snapshot_value->'scenarios'->scenario_code;<br>    IF jsonb_typeof(scenario_value) <> 'object' OR<br>       (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(scenario_value)) <> 7 OR<br>       NOT scenario_value ?& ARRAY[<br>         'salePrice','landedCost','platformFee','fulfillmentFee',<br>         'advertisingCost','returnCost','contribution'<br>       ] THEN<br>      RETURN FALSE;<br>    END IF;<br><br>    FOREACH amount_code IN ARRAY ARRAY[<br>      'salePrice','landedCost','platformFee','fulfillmentFee',<br>      'advertisingCost','returnCost'<br>    ] LOOP<br>      range_value := scenario_value->amount_code;<br>      IF jsonb_typeof(range_value) <> 'object' OR<br>         (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(range_value)) <> 4 OR<br>         NOT range_value ?& ARRAY['min','max','basis','evidenceRefs'] OR<br>         jsonb_typeof(range_value->'min') <> 'string' OR<br>         range_value->>'min' !~ '^(0\|[1-9][0-9]{0,11})(\.[0-9]{1,4})?$' OR<br>         jsonb_typeof(range_value->'max') <> 'string' OR<br>         range_value->>'max' !~ '^(0\|[1-9][0-9]{0,11})(\.[0-9]{1,4})?$' OR<br>         (range_value->>'min')::NUMERIC > (range_value->>'max')::NUMERIC OR<br>         jsonb_typeof(range_value->'basis') <> 'string' OR<br>         range_value->>'basis' NOT IN ('evidence','assumption') OR<br>         jsonb_typeof(range_value->'evidenceRefs') <> 'array' OR<br>         jsonb_array_length(range_value->'evidenceRefs') > 100 THEN<br>        RETURN FALSE;<br>      END IF;<br><br>      refs_value := range_value->'evidenceRefs';<br>      IF EXISTS (<br>        SELECT 1<br>        FROM jsonb_array_elements(refs_value) AS ref(value)<br>        WHERE jsonb_typeof(ref.value) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR<br>          ref.value #>> '{}' !~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'<br>      ) THEN<br>        RETURN FALSE;<br>      END IF;<br>      SELECT count(*) = count(DISTINCT ref.value #>> '{}')<br>        INTO refs_are_unique<br>        FROM jsonb_array_elements(refs_value) AS ref(value);<br>      IF NOT refs_are_unique OR<br>         (range_value->>'basis' = 'evidence' AND jsonb_array_length(refs_value) = 0) OR<br>         (range_value->>'basis' = 'assumption' AND jsonb_array_length(refs_value) <> 0) THEN<br>        RETURN FALSE;<br>      END IF;<br>    END LOOP;<br><br>    contribution_value := scenario_value->'contribution';<br>    IF jsonb_typeof(contribution_value) <> 'object' OR<br>       (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(contribution_value)) <> 2 OR<br>       NOT contribution_value ?& ARRAY['min','max'] OR<br>       jsonb_typeof(contribution_value->'min') <> 'string' OR<br>       contribution_value->>'min' !~ '^-?(0\|[1-9][0-9]{0,12})(\.[0-9]{1,4})?$' OR<br>       jsonb_typeof(contribution_value->'max') <> 'string' OR<br>       contribution_value->>'max' !~ '^-?(0\|[1-9][0-9]{0,12})(\.[0-9]{1,4})?$' THEN<br>      RETURN FALSE;<br>    END IF;<br>  END LOOP;<br><br>  contribution_value := snapshot_value->'scenarios'->'conservative'->'contribution';<br>  IF (contribution_value->>'min')::NUMERIC < 0 THEN<br>    IF negative_reason IS NULL THEN<br>      RETURN NOT require_negative_reason;<br>    END IF;<br>    RETURN length(btrim(negative_reason)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000;<br>  END IF;<br>  RETURN negative_reason IS NULL;<br>END;<br>$function$<br> |
| reject_work_order_fact_application_mutation | — | trigger | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reject_work_order_fact_application_mutation()<br> RETURNS trigger<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br>AS $function$<br>BEGIN<br>  RAISE EXCEPTION 'work_order_fact_application is immutable';<br>END;<br>$function$<br> |
| validate_canonical_event_domain_fact | — | trigger | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_canonical_event_domain_fact()<br> RETURNS trigger<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br> SET search_path TO 'public'<br>AS $function$<br>BEGIN<br>  IF NEW."domain_fact_id" IS NULL THEN<br>    RETURN NEW;<br>  END IF;<br>  IF NEW."domain_fact_type" = 'lifecycle_date_fact' THEN<br>    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "lifecycle_date_fact" WHERE "id" = NEW."domain_fact_id") THEN<br>      RAISE EXCEPTION 'canonical event lifecycle date fact does not exist';<br>    END IF;<br>  ELSIF NEW."domain_fact_type" = 'shipment_handoff' THEN<br>    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "shipment_handoff_record" WHERE "id"::text = NEW."domain_fact_id") THEN<br>      RAISE EXCEPTION 'canonical event shipment handoff does not exist';<br>    END IF;<br>  ELSE<br>    RAISE EXCEPTION 'canonical event domain fact type is unsupported';<br>  END IF;<br>  RETURN NEW;<br>END;<br>$function$<br> |

## 触发器

| 表 | 名称 | 约束触发器 | 定义 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| canonical_event | canonical_event_domain_fact_exists | 是 | CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER canonical_event_domain_fact_exists AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF domain_fact_id, domain_fact_type ON canonical_event DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION validate_canonical_event_domain_fact() |
| work_order_fact_application | work_order_fact_application_immutable | 否 | CREATE TRIGGER work_order_fact_application_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON work_order_fact_application FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION reject_work_order_fact_application_mutation() |
